## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and link the maintainer-approved Issue.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests pass.
- [ ] Android tests and debug build pass when Android behavior is affected.
- [ ] Documentation, supported scope, privacy, and third-party notices are updated when needed.
- [ ] No credential, signing material, private endpoint, recording, raw frame, transcript, or personal data is included.

## Provenance statement

- Paths changed:
- Entirely original work by the contributor: yes/no
- External sources, repositories, commits, documents, or generated scaffolds:
- Applicable license or terms for every external input:
- Copied or adapted code, UI, asset, or fixture:
- Notices preserved or added:

- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under the terms applicable to the target files.
- [ ] I did not remove or rewrite an upstream notice merely to make a file appear first-party.
- [ ] I understand that this app repository has no app-wide MIT/OSI license.
